title: Application Rate for 2-room Flexi Flats by Singles and General Public
what_it_is: Application Rate for 2-room Flexi Flats by Singles and General Public

sections.label: Singles buying flats with parents
sections.summary: Singles may form a family nucleus with parents to jointly buy any BTO flat type, while larger flats for singles need careful consideration.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: On the second question that the Member raised, singles who wish to live with their parents can, indeed, form a family nucleus with their parents and jointly purchase a BTO flat of any type together.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As for the request for singles to buy a larger 3-room flat, that is something we will have to consider very carefully, bearing in mind the impact it will have on the longer-term overall demand-supply balance of the public housing market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: I remember when I started in the Ministry of National Development in 2015, application rates were in the double digits.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Now, we have managed to bring it down but it is still slightly on the high side and I think we will need time to ensure that the situation is stabilised before we consider any further moves.

sections.label: First-timers non-mature estate flats
sections.summary: First-timers buying a flat in a non-mature estate are assured of getting an HDB flat within three tries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The answer to that is, indeed, through that additional chance, we are able to assure first-timers buying a flat in a non-mature estate, virtually all of them are able to do so within three tries today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will continue to ensure that for first-timers buying a flat in a non-mature estate, within three tries, through the processes that we have, they should be able to get an HDB flat.

sections.label: BTO application rates and singles
sections.summary: Virtually all non-mature estate BTO applicants get a flat within three tries, but more flats must be built before considering priority for singles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If you look at BTO applications in non-mature estates, within three tries, virtually all of them get it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This goes back to my earlier point that we have just opened up the market to singles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We have brought the application rate down to three, and I acknowledge it is still on the high side.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we still fundamentally have to build more flats and stabilise the situation before we can consider any priority for that matter, for first-timer applicants who are singles.
